title: Dear Globe Exchange Users,
body_markdown:
**Dear Globe Exchange Users,**


On Monday, the **21st of February, 2022, at 1:00 PM (UTC)** , we will begin the migration of our servers to Tokyo. This process will take approximately **five hours to complete** . The exchange will be unavailable during this process, including all withdrawals and deposits. Additionally, the exchange will preserve all trades/positions, the API will not change, and staking will not be affected. Rest assured that all of your assets and personal information will be secure during this migration process, and we will release an additional announcement once the process is complete.


Globe has decided to move our infrastructure and servers to Tokyo to align better with other exchanges. Most of the larger exchanges are already there and have previously made this migration. Relocating Globe’s infrastructure to Tokyo will help our market makers compare prices across multiple top-tier exchanges with lower latency. Automated trading applications will get better latency the closer they are to Tokyo also. This will help to give our users more confidence and better liquidity on all of Globe’s markets. Additionally, as part of the move to Tokyo, we have invested in enhanced caching, which will improve the responsiveness of our website for all users. Since Globe is Built Different and has always maintained that we are the fastest and most secure platform, this migration will ensure that we continue to be!


**We appreciate your support!**


Globe Exchange Team
